text.tspan: The Gini coefficient measures inequality on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate higher inequality. Suicide
deaths are underreported in many countries due to social stigma and cultural or legal concerns. This data is
based on modeling of global suicide patterns, and includes adjustments and extrapolations that aim to account
Suicide rate (deaths per 100,000 people; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: World Health Organization (2024); World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Depending on the country and year, inequality data relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.

text.tspan: The suicide rate is age-standardized. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2025 is shown
